title: Theory of uncertain probability: can we derive the probability density function of uncertain random experiments with continuously changing conditions?
summary: This paper aims to explore the formation mechanism of probability distribution in situations where the differences among random experiments are distinguishable, and these differences continue to evolve along with the dynamic changes in conditions and their mechanisms of action. To this end, we are motivated to devise a new theoretical system -- theory of uncertain prob ability (TUP) with Kolmogorov's system and nonlinear theories as special cases.
